---
title: Events
---

This page lists all curated frost events currently included in the benchmark dataset.

```{r country}

index_files <- "events" |>
    here::here() |>
    list.files(pattern = "index.qmd", recursive = TRUE) 
dir_name <- dirname(index_files)
index_files <- index_files[!(dir_name == ".")]
countries <- gsub("(.*)/index.qmd", "\\1", index_files)
tibble::tibble(
        Country = paste0("[", 
            tools::toTitleCase(countries), "](", index_files, ")")
    ) |>
    knitr::kable()
```

## Notes

- Spatial boundaries are approximate and intended for regional-scale analysis.
- Evidence quality and impact reporting may vary across events.
